_comment: Thunderstore-profile manifest exported from the Valheim mod manager on the
Windows box. This is the RECORD of which mod versions the server is meant
to run - it is not consumed by any automation here (see the Valheim section
in agents.md: mods are copied across by hand).
Keeping it in git is the point. The server self-updates the Valheim build
unattended, so knowing which plugin versions were working at a given game
build is what makes a bad update diagnosable and recoverable.
Gale writes `dependencies` as a list of `Namespace-Name-Version` strings.
Note that this is a SPLIT source, not a clean replacement: 15 of these pins
resolve only on Hexium and the other 19 only on Thunderstore, because the
Azumatt suite and a few others have moved to Hexium while the rest have not.
Deliberately anonymous: the profile/world name and the server description
from the original export have been removed, since this repo is public.
name: valheim-lan
